newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends down as commercials cover shorts.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends down as commercials cover shorts.

text.p: WCE canola futures ended down as commercials covered shorts, traders said.

"Cargill covered August, September and November shorts, there were light hedges and we're watching the weather," a trader said. November WCE canola crush profit margins fell to -6.48 Thursday from -6.06 Wednesday. Aug-Nov $8, Nov Jan $5.
Japan bought 3,000-4,000 tonnes of canola overnight, sources said.
August canola lost $1.20 to $353.30, November fell $2.70 to $341.50. July flax fell $4 to $314 and November lost $2.30 to $278.70. UGG bought 85 July-Sep at $35. Volume was 200.
October western barley lost $0.50 to $126.30 on commercial selling spurred by CBOT corn, December rose $0.10 to $127.90. July-Oct spread at $2.50, Oct-Dec $1.20. Volume was 470 lots.
October feed wheat fell $1.10 to $150.50, December lost $0.40 to $151.80 on commercials. Volume was 293 lots.
Louis Dreyfus sold 35 December oats down US$2.10 at US$106.90 to UGG and PCTS, a trader said.
Louis Dreyfus also sold October, December and February feed peas down US$0.50 to US$1.20 to US$165.50, US$166 and US$168 respectively. Volume was 25 lots.
(All values in Canadian dollars except oats, feed peas).
